name: CKEditor GLightbox Inline
description: A text filter that opens inline images in a GLightbox lightbox.
project_description:
How It Works 
 This module integrates with the GLightbox library . To use GLightbox to display your images, you usually need to manually add specific HTML tags and CSS classes.

 With this module, there's no need for manual adjustments. It adds a text filter that automatically prepares your images for GLightbox. Simply insert your images as you normally would, and they will open in GLightbox.

 Does it work with CKEditor? 
 Yes! You can insert images into CKEditor as usual, and the module will handle the rest.

 How to Enable the Text Filter 
 If you're new to Drupal, refer to the official documentation for detailed instructions.

 Dependencies 
 
 GLightbox
